title: Q calendar

syncNotice.title: What syncs with Google Calendar
syncNotice.workspaceBody: Only events shared with the workspace are pushed to the connected Google Calendar. Team-private and personal events are never added to the team calendar. If you edit a PlanQ-created event in Google, its title, description, location, time, and recurrence come back to PlanQ within a few minutes. Events you create in Google do not become PlanQ events — they are only shown alongside on this screen.
syncNotice.personalBody: Your connected Google Calendar events are shown here for viewing only (read-only). Events you create in PlanQ are not pushed to your personal Google Calendar.
syncNotice.personalBodyRead: Your connected Google Calendar events are shown here for reference only (read-only). To send PlanQ events to your Google Calendar, reconnect the account.
syncNotice.personalBodyWrite: Your Google Calendar events are shown here, and PlanQ events are added to your Google Calendar too. Private events go only to your own calendar, never the team calendar. You can turn this off per event.
syncNotice.workspaceBroken: The workspace connection lacks calendar permission — Meet links and sync will not work. Reconnect in Settings > Files & Integrations.
syncNotice.brokenTitle: The team Google Calendar connection is broken
syncNotice.brokenOwner: Events are not going out to the team calendar, and edits made in Google are not coming back. Reconnect with the button below.
syncNotice.brokenMember: Events are not going out to the team calendar, and edits made in Google are not coming back. A workspace owner needs to reconnect.
syncNotice.brokenHowTo: While connecting: ① if you see an "unverified app" warning, choose [Advanced] → [Continue], and ② make sure the "Calendar" item is checked on the consent screen. Without it the connection still looks successful.
syncNotice.delayHint: Edits made in Google are applied automatically within {{minutes}} minute(s). Press "Fetch now" to check immediately.
syncNotice.syncFailed: Could not fetch right now. Please try again shortly.
syncNotice.backfilled_one: Pushed {{count}} pending event to the team calendar.
syncNotice.backfilled_other: Pushed {{count}} pending events to the team calendar.
syncNotice.orphanHint: PlanQ can no longer manage these copies. Select the ones to delete.
syncNotice.cleanFailed: Could not clean up. Please try again shortly.
